class.name: BoneClothWind3D
class.description: Blows along the node's -Z axis on every [BoneClothSimulator3D] in the same world. Several winds add up, and hiding the node turns it off. The wind wavers on its own, so hair and clothes keep moving while the character stands still.

members.member: How far, in radians, the wind's direction drifts from the node's -Z axis. A breeze then comes from slightly different sides over time. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How long the direction takes to drift, in seconds.
How fast the wind wavers, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]2.0[/code]. The rate also rises with [member strength].
How hard the wind pushes, in meters per second squared. Each simulator scales it by its [member BoneClothSimulator3D.wind_influence/value]. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
How much the wind wavers in direction and strength, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]2.0[/code]. At [code]0.0[/code] the wind blows steadily, and hair and clothes settle and hold still.
